accessibility.evidence: Native labelled radios, buttons and details inspected. Keyboard Tab exposed the skip link; Enter moved to the lab; ArrowRight selected unchanged with a visible parent outline. A keyboard-triggered production request restored focus to Run with a visible outline. Polite atomic verdict and alert markup reviewed. Main text contrast 7.25:1 or higher on panel; button 13.32:1. Production CSSOM contains the reduced-motion override. No screen-reader session or OS reduced-motion emulation was performed.

responsive.evidence: 1440x900 shows run controls, measured counters and decision in the first viewport. 390x844 has stacked controls, readable results and no horizontal page overflow (client/scroll width 390/390). Expanded code panels scroll internally. 720x450 reflow also inspected (705/705 client/scroll width including scrollbar). This is a reflow proxy; actual 200% browser zoom was not independently confirmed.

loading.evidence: Local controlled 3.5-second response showed Measuring, disabled radios/actions, blank stable metrics and Checking the Query status; loading.jpg.

empty.evidence: Fresh load shows dashes, Ready to Measure, disabled Export and enabled Run/Recorded controls. Deep-link reload selects unchanged without executing D1.

error.evidence: Local test-only HTTP 503 displayed actionable alert, no stale metrics and restored controls; recorded run then loaded the original timestamp successfully. error.jpg.

partial.reason: The endpoint is atomic for all five query results and rejects incomplete measurements. Frontend shape validation plus catch clears incomplete render attempts rather than exposing a partial success.

success.evidence: Published custom-domain browser runs: missing-index 20/1100 and budget failure; unchanged 20/20 pass; wrong-result 20/1 correctness failure. All have live provenance. Recorded report separately labelled with original capture time. Fonts loaded and production browser error/warning log empty.

permission.reason: The public fixed-query demo requires no visitor login, permission grant or credentials; authentication is only a deployment concern.

renderedEvidence.observation: Published live missing-index comparison with 20 vs 1100 reads, same results, shared scale and 100-read markers; desktop workbench layout.
Published wrong-result comparison, controls stacked, 20 vs 1 reads, correctness rejection and visible keyboard focus.
Narrow desktop reflow proxy with stacked scenario controls, no horizontal page overflow.

limitations: Manual Chrome review, not a complete assistive-technology audit.
Reduced-motion CSS inspected in the loaded stylesheet; OS media preference not emulated.
Actual browser zoom shortcuts did not change the viewport; narrow reflow tested instead.
